#3038: FIXED. This link is a before/after, not a live repro.

TraceRay() and RayQuery::TraceRayInline() sharing one RayDesc instance used to
crash the compiler.

  dxc_1_6_2112 pane : fails -- this release is inside the broken window.
  dxc_trunk pane    : compiles cleanly.

Locally the crash spans v1.5.2010 through v1.8.2502 and is gone from v1.8.2505
onward. @tex3d's 2020 workaround (copy the RayDesc into a second variable) is no
longer needed on current builds.
